title: Construct sharp signings for dense and every complete prescribed base
statement: For n>=64,t=n-1-d between0 andsqrt(n)/4, set N=next power2>=n, label vertices0..n-1 and output s_uv=(-1)^popcount(u AND v) on ORIGINAL edges. Symmetric Walsh H_N obeys H_N^2=N I. Its leading principal compression H has norm<=sqrtN, removed diagonal norm1 and missing-edge matrix norm<=t, hence ||A_s||<=sqrtN+1+t<2sqrt(d-1). The source proves the strict inequality via sqrt2+3/8<sqrt15/2. Complement t-regularity gives unsigned nontrivial eigenvalues abs<=t+1<2sqrt(d-1); d>n/2 makes these bases connected/nonbipartite. Thus this is an INFINITE variable-degree positive family. All complete K_n,n>=4 also work: Walsh for n>=6, explicit K4 rows(0,1,1,1),(1,0,-1,-1),(1,-1,0,1),(1,-1,1,0), char(x^2-5)(x^2-1); K5 rows(0,1,1,1,1),(1,0,-1,-1,-1),(1,-1,0,-1,-1),(1,-1,-1,0,1),(1,-1,-1,1,0), char(x-1)^2(x+1)(x^2+x-8). Their norms sqrt5 and(1+sqrt33)/2 meet strict sharp bounds. O(n^2 logn) BIT output preserves every edge; no Ramanujan/spectral oracle.
